summary: Dowry death conviction challenge; essential ingredients of Sections 304-B IPC and Section 113-B Evidence Act examined; prior omissions as contradictions under Section 162 CrPC; uncorroborated allegations of dowry demands (jeep, furniture, buffalo); presumption under Section 113-B requires proven cruelty 'soon before' death; inconsistencies in witness testimony (PW-6); insufficient evidence of harassment for dowry; conviction set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellant acquitted.
